title: Super Mario World Ending Theme sight-read by Tom Brier
summary: Pianist Tom Brier sight-reads a piano arrangement of the Super Mario World ending theme, working from a first-draft score by Keeper1st. He takes some liberties with the score as he plays.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a showcase of remarkable sight-reading and a favorite when sight-reading or notation comes up.

quote.text: He's a rare gem and a treat to the ears.
